Hormuz transits remain critically low, while Houthis have resumed attacks in the Red Sea. The RIMPAC exercise is underway with USS Theodore Roosevelt leading a group sail. Meanwhile, TKMS and Navantia advance a strategic submarine partnership, and the White House pushes back against congressional restrictions on buying foreign warships.

- **CHAOS missile contract awarded**: US Navy selects CoAspire for the Coalition Heterogenous Affordable Offensive Strike program to deliver low-cost cruise missiles for allied maritime strike ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/24/u-s-navy-orders-low-cost-missiles-to-expand-fleet-allied-long-range-maritime-strike-capabilities)).
